column1: # The rule of a proxy's exclusion list (the proxy record's unit S2), read by the engine's connect::excluded and by
# the network part's NetworkProxy.excluded, its twin on the Kotlin side. Columns: the host, a name or an address
# written out; the exclusion list, comma-separated entries as Android's setting holds them, "-" for none; and
# whether the host is excluded (1 or 0). An IPv6 host's brackets are dropped, an entry's are not. Only ASCII letters
# are folded: the last row's entry starts with the Kelvin sign (U+212A), which neither side takes for "k".
